key_claims: Thicker conjugated-polymer HTLs increase reverse-breakdown robustness (more negative Vrb).
Electrochemically stable back electrodes improve Vrb and reduce reverse-bias degradation.
Mitigation should consider ITO planarization (avoid perovskite touching ITO), blocking electron injection, and stable electrodes.

observed_benchmark.note: Record-scale reverse breakdown reported for PSCs (comparable to Si).
